title: Variable-Time-Step GRU for Transient Magnetic Hysteresis Modeling: implementation, released model weights, and archived hyperparameter-search logs
description:
Reproduction package for the manuscript Variable-Time-Step GRU for Transient Magnetic Hysteresis Modeling.

It contains the implementation of the fixed-update GRU, the GRU with the time step as an input (DtInputGRU), the time-step-scaled GRU, and the rate-update GRU; the selected configuration of every reported experiment; twenty-three released checkpoints with SHA-256 checksums (thirteen N87 models and one per-material model for each of ten soft ferrites); 239 sanitized per-run training logs documenting the reported hyperparameter searches; scripts that recompute every reported metric; and generators for all manuscript figures.

Version 1.1.0 follows the first revision of the manuscript. It adds the two models of the revised comparison (DtInputGRU and RateGRU-Orig) and, in a separate review_response folder, the code and results of the analyses carried out in response to the reviewers, including a zero-shot comparison with TimesFM-3. The TimesFM-3 weights are not included; they are subject to their own non-commercial license.

Measurement data is not included. The experiments use the MagNetX transient hysteresis dataset (Kwon et al., IEEE APEC 2025, doi:10.1109/APEC48143.2025.10977252).
